description: Search and export photos from Tommy's Apple Photos (iCloud Photos) library on this Mac by content: AI caption, OCR text in the image, labels, people, places and dates, with osxphotos. Exports a fast local preview or the full original downloaded from iCloud, without opening the Photos app. Use when the user asks to find a photo, screenshot, receipt, document, sticker or picture in their photos or camera roll, or to send one to Discord.
